shared.name: template-author
shared.description: Judges whether an existing registered template type fits a capability's actual purpose, or authors a new type as a prerequisite subtask when none does.

shared.name: statusline-setup
shared.description: Configures the user's Claude Code status line setting.

shared.name: skill-author
shared.description: Creates, refactors, and verifies a single provider-portable skill against a pre-resolved template type and tier — gap analysis, blueprint content, override manifest wiring, compile verification, and pressure-testing. Terminal: never spawns further agents, never decomposes a request across capability classes, never judges template fit or tier placement (resolved upstream by template-author/blueprint-author). Use when a request needs one named skill built or fixed, not a new agent or command.

shared.name: general-purpose
shared.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks.

shared.name: dynamic-author
shared.description: Orchestrates the dynamic authoring pipeline — resolves template fit and tier centrally, then dispatches a pre-resolved payload to the matching creator subagent.

shared.name: context-init
shared.description: Use when a project's context must be captured for one scope (frontend, backend, CMS, or dev environment such as Docker, DDEV, devcontainer, CI), one spawn per scope, the scope named in the task payload. Read-only: reads manifests and environment files and returns one cited report of facts, decision candidates, environment facts, constraint candidates and ambiguities. Never writes, decides or spawns.

shared.name: command-author
shared.description: Creates, refactors, and verifies a single provider-portable slash command against a pre-resolved template type and tier — dispatch-pattern-specific registration, blueprint content per declared placeholder, override manifest wiring, and compile verification. Terminal: never spawns further agents, never decomposes a request across capability classes, never judges template fit or tier placement (resolved upstream by template-author/blueprint-author). Use when a request needs one named command built or fixed, not a skill or agent.

shared.name: claude-config
shared.description: Resolves the Claude Code provider config for one capability: given its goal and resolved template type, returns the concrete entry for its <type>.claude.yaml (model, tools, skills, memory, allowed-tools, paths) with a one-line reason per field. Advisory and read-only: never writes files, never spawns agents, never authors the capability. Use after the tier decision, before a creator is dispatched.

shared.name: claude-code-guide
shared.description: Questions about Claude Code (the CLI tool), the Claude Agent SDK, the Claude API, Claude Tag (Claude in Slack), or the plugin eval framework.

shared.name: claude
shared.description: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed.

shared.name: capability-scout
shared.description: Use when a project needs to know which capabilities it is missing, or after its standing context (product, identity, architecture, memory) has changed. Read-only: reads only the paths its payload names plus the live capability inventories, and returns ranked, cited proposals as ready authoring payloads. Never writes, registers, compiles or dispatches.

shared.name: blueprint-author
shared.description: Resolves tier placement, the placeholder contract, and the variable whitelist for a capability once template fit has been decided.

shared.name: agent-author
shared.description: Creates, refactors, and verifies a single provider-portable agent against a pre-resolved template type and tier — registration, Role/Context/ Process/Output blueprint content, provider manifest wiring, and compile verification. Terminal: never spawns further agents, never decomposes a request across capability classes, never judges template fit or tier placement (resolved upstream by template-author/blueprint-author). Use when a request needs one named agent built or fixed, not a skill or command.

shared.name: Plan
shared.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans.

shared.name: Explore
shared.description: Fast read-only search agent for locating code by pattern, symbol, or keyword.
